cleaner.label: Claude Code
cleaner.description: Cache and factory-wipe cleaners for Claude Code

option.label: Cache
option.description: Delete Claude Code caches, logs, and temporary files.
option.warning: Close Claude Code before cleaning. This preserves most settings and project files.

option.label: Factory wipe
option.description: Delete Claude Code user-level local state.
option.warning: This removes Claude Code user settings, memory, agents, sessions, auth-related state, logs, and caches. It also removes $HOME/.claude.json if present.
